project.title: Standardised Warehouse Move & Loading Efficiency Program
project.objective: Design and roll out standard procedures to make warehouse moves and loading operations faster, safer, and more consistent across shifts.
deliverables: Documented standard operating procedures for moving and loading activities
Shift-ready loading and stacking checklists for movers and factory hands
Updated warehouse move schedule and staffing plan
Training brief and quick-reference safety guideline for handling loads
Simple tracking sheet for incidents, delays, and rework during moves
constraints: All procedures must comply with existing health and safety regulations
No additional full-time staff; use current team and shifts
Minimal disruption to ongoing warehouse operations during rollout
New procedures must be usable by mixed-experience crews
Documentation must be printable on one or two pages per station

risks.risk: Crew members ignore new procedures and keep using old habits.
risks.mitigation: Involve movers and factory hands in drafting SOPs and run short on-shift briefings.

risks.risk: New loading sequence slows down operations during peak hours.
risks.mitigation: Pilot procedures on one shift, measure impact, and adjust before full rollout.

risks.risk: Documentation is too complex for quick use on the floor.
risks.mitigation: Use checklists and diagrams, test with a small group, and simplify wording.

risks.risk: Safety requirements conflict with tight dispatch timelines.
risks.mitigation: Align with logistics planner to build safety steps into standard time estimates.

themes.why_relevant: Core to movers and factory hands; reduces injuries and damage.
Needed to align how different shifts and crews perform moves.
Office clerk must align paperwork, crews, and time windows.
Forklifts, cranes, and tools must be used within limits and planned ahead.
Data from the floor will show if the new process is working.

backlog.task: Map current move and loading steps for a typical inbound and outbound shift
definition_of_done: List of current steps for inbound and outbound moves documented
Pain points and delays identified with input from at least one mover and one factory hand
Summary shared in the channel for review

backlog.task: Draft standard loading sequence for mixed cargo pallets and containers
definition_of_done: Draft loading sequence covers at least three common cargo types
Weight distribution and equipment capacity limits clearly noted
Sequence reviewed by one factory hand and office clerk

backlog.task: Create a one-page checklist for pre-move equipment and safety checks
definition_of_done: Checklist includes PPE, equipment condition, and area clearance checks
Checklist tested on one real shift and feedback collected
Final version uploaded and printed-ready

backlog.task: Design a simple incident and delay log for moves
definition_of_done: Log captures date, shift, type of issue, and root cause notes
Format agreed by movers and factory hands as quick to fill
Log template stored and link shared in channel

backlog.task: Define standard roles and responsibilities during a large warehouse move
definition_of_done: Role list covers movers, factory hands, and supervisor
Hand-off points between roles clearly described
Team confirms responsibilities in channel

backlog.task: Pilot the new loading sequence and safety checklist on one outbound shift
definition_of_done: Pilot shift completed using new sequence and checklist
Any incidents, delays, or confusion logged in the incident sheet
Short summary of results posted in channel

backlog.task: Adjust SOPs based on pilot feedback and finalise version 1.0
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least two movers and two factory hands reviewed
SOP document updated and versioned as 1.0
Final SOP shared and acknowledged by team

backlog.task: Prepare quick-reference visual guide for stacking and securing loads
definition_of_done: Guide includes diagrams or simple sketches for stacking patterns
Includes notes on dangerous goods and fragile items
Guide validated by a mover for practicality

backlog.task: Set up weekly review routine for incidents and delays
definition_of_done: Recurring time agreed with team for quick review
Agenda defined focusing on top 3 issues and actions
First review session completed and actions logged

backlog.task: Document standard cleaning and reset steps after each move
definition_of_done: List of cleaning tasks and responsible roles documented
Time estimate per area agreed with movers
Steps added as a section in the main SOP

backlog.task: Identify training needs and plan short on-shift briefings
definition_of_done: Key topics for briefings listed from SOP and checklists
Briefing slots aligned with shift changes
Plan shared and confirmed by at least one mover and one factory hand

backlog.task: Collect before-and-after feedback on workload and safety perception
definition_of_done: At least three crew members provide short feedback
Feedback summarised into 3–5 key points
Summary posted in channel and linked to incident log data

artifacts.title: Incident and Delay Tracking Log

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current move process and main problems to fix
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to describe how moves and loading are done now

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the top three issues the new procedures must address first.
Confirm which typical shift (time and type of cargo) will be used as the reference flow.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and refine the standard loading sequence and safety checks
threads_plan.trigger: Mover shares first draft of loading sequence and asks for comments

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final loading sequence steps for version 1.0 of the SOP.
Decide which safety checks must always be done before loading starts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and confirm the pilot shift for the new procedures
threads_plan.trigger: Office clerk proposes a specific shift and cargo mix for the pilot

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm date, time, and crew for the pilot shift.
Agree what data and feedback must be captured during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and finalise SOP and guides
threads_plan.trigger: Post-pilot summary message with incidents, delays, and crew feedback

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve SOP version 1.0 and visual guides for rollout.
Decide on any immediate changes needed before full rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up ongoing routines for training and weekly reviews
threads_plan.trigger: Office clerk shares proposal for shift briefings and weekly review slot

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the weekly review day and time for all shifts.
Confirm how incidents and feedback will be collected before each review.

channel_rituals: Daily quick async check-in at shift start to flag any move or loading issues.
Weekly 20-minute review thread to discuss incidents and delays from the log.
Post-pilot debrief thread after any test of new procedures or checklists.
Pre-rollout confirmation thread before applying new SOPs to all shifts.
